findings.description: Coming to get Shannon becomes taking her home.

contexts.WH: "Shannon.  Does that sort of world really need to be yours?  Let me be honest with you.  ......Shannon.  I didn't just invite you here.  I came to take you home."

I came to take you home."

findings.sourceReading: The witch says she has not merely invited Shannon: she came to get her.
